parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposures are documented and recent: a 2025 top-court ruling defining sex as biological for the equality act's single-sex services; a national transport police strip-search policy assigning trans women to officers of sex at birth; a regional police interim policy searching by biological sex, with lived-gender officers only on request; a 2026 ruling and government defence of birth-sex prison housing; and an in-force 2026 statutory code on single-sex spaces. These are universal-exposure measures (search, custody, facilities) that reach any outed visitor, and there is no documented working remedy for trans people. Mitigating: medical transition and GRC issuance continue, a 2025 ruling preserves gender-reassignment discrimination protection, hate-crime coverage is partial, and there is no criminal statute targeting trans people. Harassment is survey-documented but the trans-specific prevalence is not clearly current. Scored in the Elevated band, lower end, given the search and custody exposures.
